system_overview: This specification provides a high-level abstract model of the termination detection problem in a ring of nodes with synchronous communication. It serves as the top-level specification in a refinement hierarchy, where Dijkstra's EWD840 algorithm is shown to implement this abstract specification. The specification captures the essential requirements of termination detection without prescribing any particular detection mechanism.
actors_and_components: The system consists of N nodes arranged in a ring. Each node can be active or inactive. A global termination detection flag indicates whether termination has been detected. The specification abstracts away the details of how detection is performed, allowing nondeterministic detection whenever all nodes are inactive.
state_variables: The system tracks: (1) the activation status of each node (active or inactive), and (2) a boolean flag indicating whether termination has been detected.
initial_state: The activation status of nodes is unconstrained (each node may be active or inactive). The termination detection flag may initially be false, or it may be true if all nodes happen to start inactive (terminated).
actions: Three types of actions are defined: (1) Terminate: an active node becomes inactive. Termination detection may (but need not) be triggered simultaneously if all nodes are now inactive. (2) Wakeup: an active node activates another node (simulating message delivery). The termination detection flag is unchanged. (3) Detect termination: when all nodes are terminated, the detection flag can be set to true. This is a separate action with weak fairness to ensure eventual detection.
safety_properties: Stability: once termination is detected, all nodes remain permanently inactive (terminated). This ensures that termination detection is not falsely triggered while some computation is still possible.
liveness_properties: If all nodes become inactive (terminated), then termination is eventually detected.
model_bounds: The number of nodes N is declared as a constant positive natural number. For model checking, N must be instantiated with a specific finite value.
additional_assumptions: Weak fairness is assumed for the detect termination action, ensuring that if all nodes are permanently inactive, detection eventually occurs. No fairness is assumed for node termination or wakeup actions. Communication is synchronous in this abstract model.
